headline: Waist-high SE windswell on a prime angle — morning log session before the sea breeze wrecks it.
today: Short-period stuff but it's coming in on the money angle, and the NE cross-off holds through morning so it'll have some shape. Get in early on a log or fish around the incoming push before the low at 11a bottoms out. By afternoon that 16mph ESE goes cross-on and turns it to slop, so dawn patrol or don't bother.

daysToWatch.note: Another prime ESE angle around 2.5ft with light NE cross-off at dawn — clean small log window before the afternoon SE onshore fills in.
Biggest of the week to near 3.8ft, but only a fair angle and short period, with ENE cross most of the day. Rideable and worth a look, not a rearrange-your-plans day.
Chest-high on a fair angle with NE cross-off through the morning — the cleanest-looking session of the stretch. Ride it before the SE cross-on shows in the afternoon.
Glassy dawn with light wind and waist-to-chest SSE swell at a longer 6.5s — grab the early window before the S onshore ramps up midday.
